Venue: XT.com
Headline: XT Finance USDT/USDC Fixed-Term Earn Bonus APR Coupon Campaign | Meet Subscription Targets and Get Up to 10% Extra APR!

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
The XT Finance USDT/USDC Fixed-Term Earn Bonus APR Coupon Campaign is now live!
During the campaign, users who subscribe to designated USDT/USDC standard fixed-term Earn products (90/180/365 days) and reach the specified cumulative valid subscription thresholds will receive exclusive bonus APR coupons based on their qualifying tier, with up to 20% additional APR!
Complete your subscriptions to unlock exclusive bonus APR benefits on your next fixed-term Earn subscription and enjoy more opportunities to earn!
Campaign Period: November 25, 2026 – December 9, 2026
## Campaign Rewards
During the campaign, users who successfully subscribe to designated USDT/USDC fixed-term Earn products and reach the corresponding cumulative subscription thresholds will receive the bonus APR coupon for their highest qualifying tier.
Cumulative Valid Subscription Amount | Bonus APR Coupon | Maximum Eligible Principal
≥500 USD | +5% APR | 500 USD
≥3,000 USD | +6% APR | 3,000 USD
≥10,000 USD | +8% APR | 10,000 USD
≥50,000 USD | +10% APR | 15,000 USD
## How to Participate
Log in to your XT account and visit the XT Finance page.
Select a designated USDT/USDC fixed-term Earn product and complete your subscription.
Reach the corresponding cumulative valid subscription threshold during the campaign to qualify for the respective bonus APR coupon.
After the campaign ends and eligibility verification is completed, eligible users will receive their corresponding coupons.
Use your coupon to subscribe to a designated USDT/USDC fixed-term Earn product within the coupon validity period and enjoy additional APR.
## Bonus APR Coupon Rules
Coupons are only applicable to designated USDT/USDC Earn products. Eligible products and terms are subject to the details stated on each coupon.
The additional APR applies for 7 days, and the maximum eligible principal is subject to the limit specified on the corresponding coupon.
Coupons are valid for 7 days from the date of issuance. Unused coupons will automatically expire after the validity period.
Each user may receive only one coupon corresponding to their highest qualifying tier. Rewards from different tiers cannot be combined.
Each coupon can only be used once and cannot be combined with other bonus APR coupons.
Any principal exceeding the coupon's maximum eligible amount will earn interest at the product's standard APR.
Coupons can only be used for eligible subsequent subscription orders and cannot be exchanged for cash, transferred, or withdrawn.
## Important Notes
Only successfully completed subscriptions to designated USDT/USDC fixed-term Earn products during the campaign period will count. Failed, canceled, and abnormal orders will be excluded.
Each user will receive a reward based on their highest qualifying cumulative valid subscription tier during the campaign. Rewards from different tiers are not cumulative.
Coupons will be distributed after the campaign ends and eligibility verification is completed. The actual arrival time is subject to the platform's distribution schedule.
Coupons are only valid for designated products. Fixed-term Earn products do not support early redemption. Please select a product term according to your financial needs.
XT reserves the right to disqualify users and revoke rewards if any improper participation is detected, including bulk account registration, fraudulent transactions, or malicious volume manipulation.
XT reserves the right to modify, interpret, or terminate the campaign rules.

Venue: Bitget
Headline: Bitget Live Streamer Rewards: Up to 20% Commission, Biweekly Leaderboard Prizes and a Guaranteed Reward Pool

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Bitget Live is rolling out a new streamer rewards program! New streamers get double commission, traffic boosts and stream bonuses. All streamers earn base commission and can climb the biweekly leaderboards for fixed prizes. Streamers who don't make the leaderboard can still share a guaranteed reward pool.
The first series Event period: 2026-11-25 00:00 – 2026-12-08 23:59 (UTC+8)
How to join: Apply to become a Bitget Live streamer here: [
Application link]
## Key definitions
New streamer: A streamer within 28 days of their first stream, including the day of the first stream
Valid stream: A stream lasting at least 60 minutes with at least one trade over 10 USDT, a saved replay, and no idle streaming, pre-recorded content, low-quality content or batch-operated accounts
Live-room trading volume: Trades completed within 1 hour after a viewer taps a token tag in your live room
## Program 1: New Streamer Welcome Pack (first 28 days)
## 1. Double commission
Earn 20% commission on attributed trading fees during your first 28 days, double the standard 10%.
## 2. Traffic boost
Hit any of the milestones below to receive 3 official promotions for your streams:
Milestone | Valid streaming days (≥60 min/day) | Live-room trading volume | Unique logged-in viewers
First 3 days | ≥ 2 days | ≥ 500 USDT | ≥ 30
First 7 days | ≥ 5 days | ≥ 1,000 USDT | ≥ 50
First 14 days | ≥ 10 days | ≥ 5,000 USDT | ≥ 100
## 3. Stream bonus
Valid streams completed | Bonus
3 streams | 2 USDT
Streams 4–6 | 2 USDT per stream
Streams 7–10 | 3 USDT per stream
Complete 10 valid streams in your first 28 days to earn up to 20 USDT.
## Program 2: Base Commission
All valid streamers earn
10% of the trading fees attributed to their live room (20% for new streamers).
## Program 3: Biweekly Leaderboards
Eligibility: Complete at least 6 valid streams in the period.
Streamers are ranked by live-room trading volume over the 2-week period. Crypto & Stocks and CFD are ranked separately, and you can win on both leaderboards. The leaderboard is updated daily on web
## Crypto & Stocks Leaderboard
Rank | Minimum biweekly volume (USDT) | Reward per streamer
1st | ≥ 1,500,000 | 500 USDT
2nd | ≥ 1,000,000 | 300 USDT
3rd | ≥ 700,000 | 220 USDT
4th | ≥ 500,000 | 150 USDT
5th | ≥ 300,000 | 100 USDT
6th–10th | ≥ 150,000 | 60 USDT
11th–15th | ≥ 100,000 | 40 USDT
16th–20th | ≥ 50,000 | 25 USDT
21st–30th | ≥ 25,000 | 15 USDT
31st–40th | ≥ 15,000 | 8 USDT
41st–50th | ≥ 10,000 | 5 USDT
## CFD trading activity
Rank | Minimum biweekly volume (USDT) | Reward per streamer
1st | ≥ 5,000,000 | 300USDT
2nd | ≥ 3,000,000 | 240USDT
3rd | ≥ 2,000,000 | 180USDT
4th–5th | ≥ 1,500,000 | 150USDT
6th–10th | ≥ 1,000,000 | 120USDT
11th–20th | ≥ 500,000 | 90USDT
21st–30th | ≥ 300,000 | 60USDT
31st–40th | ≥ 200,000 | 30USDT
41st–50th | ≥ 100,000 | 15USDT
51st–60th | ≥ 50,000 | 10USDT
## Reward rules
To claim a tier's reward, you must rank within that tier and meet its minimum volume
If you rank within a tier but miss its minimum volume, you'll receive the highest tier your volume qualifies for. Each tier has a fixed number of spots, filled in ranking order; once a tier is full, you move to the next one
Each streamer can claim only one tier per leaderboard per period
## Program 4: Guaranteed Reward Pool
Valid streamers who don't win a leaderboard prize can share the guaranteed reward pool. The more valid streams all streamers complete together, the bigger the pool.
Eligibility: At least 3 valid streams every week during the period
Level | Total valid streams by all eligible streamers | Reward per streamer
Level 1 | ≥ 75 | 4 USDT (up to 40 streamers)
Level 2 | ≥ 85 | 6 USDT (up to 50 streamers)
Level 3 | ≥ 100 | 8 USDT (up to 60 streamers)
If more streamers qualify than there are spots, rewards will go to streamers in order of overall performance, including stream quality, trading volume and viewers, until the pool runs out.
## Related Links
Bitget Live Streaming Homepage
Local Live Streaming Tutorial
OBS Live Streaming Tutorial
## Terms and conditions
Idle streaming, pre-recorded content, streams without a saved replay, low-quality content and batch-operated accounts do not count as valid streams. Violators will be disqualified
The same trade cannot count toward both Bitget Live and Bitget Insights rewards. In case of overlap, it will count toward Bitget Live.
Live-streaming commissions are a separate reward and can be combined with other commissions—such, such as those from copy trading or referrals—up, up to a cumulative maximum commission rate of 70%.
New streamers compete on the same leaderboards as everyone else, and still receive their double commission and stream bonuses.
Rewards will be distributed to winners' spot accounts within 7 business days after each period ends.
Bitget may disqualify any user and revoke or reclaim rewards in cases of cheating, violations or malicious behavior.
Bitget reserves the right to modify, suspend or terminate this program at any time without prior notice.

Venue: Bitget
Headline: Bitget Insights Creator Incentive Program is now live! With a total prize pool of 10,000 USDT, you can earn up to 200 USDT individually—simply post to qualify. First come, first served!

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
The new Bitget Insights Creator Rewards program is live! It includes three campaigns, each running in 2-week periods for 5 periods, with a total prize pool of 10,000 USDT.
Whether you write in-depth research, new token analysis or trading insights, there's a reward for you.
The first series
Event period:2026-11-25 00:00 – 2026-12-08 23:59（UTC+8）
[Click to join the Bitget Insights]
## Campaign 1: Featured Creators Leaderboard (500 USDT per period)
Eligibility: Publish at least 3 original, valid posts in a period to enter automatically.
Scoring: Total score = Content quality score × 50% + Trading volume score × 50%
Content quality: Scored by the Bitget Insights team on originality, depth and data support, topic relevance and timeliness, and readability, using the average of your 3 best posts in the period
Trading volume: Based on your ranking by attributed trading volume from your posts in the period. Creators with no attributed volume score 0
Rank | Reward per creator
1st | 50 USDT
2nd | 40 USDT
3rd | 35 USDT
4th–10th | 25 USDT
11th–20th | 20 USDT
Winners (nicknames and winning posts) will be announced on Bitget Insights each period.
## Campaign 2: Content Mining Leaderboard (up to 1,000 USDT per period)
Eligibility: Publish at least 3 original, valid posts with a token tag in a period.
Ranking: By attributed trading volume in the period, meaning trades completed within 1 hour after a reader taps a token tag in your post and enters the trading page.
Rank | Minimum trading volume (USDT) | Reward per creator
1st | ≥ 1,200,000 | 150 USDT
2nd | ≥ 800,000 | 100 USDT
3rd | ≥ 550,000 | 80 USDT
4th–5th | ≥ 400,000 | 50 USDT
6th–10th | ≥ 300,000 | 30 USDT
11th–20th | ≥ 150,000 | 20 USDT
21st–30th | ≥ 100,000 | 12 USDT
31st–50th | ≥ 50,000 | 5 USDT
## Reward rules
To claim a tier's reward, you must rank within that tier and meet its minimum volume
If you rank within a tier but miss its minimum volume, you'll receive the highest tier your volume qualifies for. Each tier has a fixed number of spots, filled in ranking order; once a tier is full, you move to the next one
Each creator can claim only one tier per period
## Terms and conditions
All entries must be original. AI-generated, spun, reposted, plagiarized, low-quality or duplicate content will be disqualified.
Content must not direct users off-platform, including but not limited to group links, contact details, QR codes, or prompts to open accounts or trade on other platforms.
Trades from the creator's own account, wash trading, volume manipulation, and trades from accounts sharing the creator's IP, device or funds do not count toward attributed volume.
Trades already counted toward Bitget Live streamer rewards will not count toward this program.
Official Bitget accounts and partner media accounts are not eligible.
Rewards from all two campaigns can be combined.
Rewards will be distributed to winners' spot accounts within 7 business days after each period ends.
Bitget may disqualify any user and revoke or reclaim rewards in cases of cheating, violations or malicious behavior.
Bitget reserves the right to modify, suspend or terminate this program at any time without prior notice.
